reason: My booking system already has an online booking button, so I don't see what an AI chat adds that I'm missing. I'd have to set up another tool, check its answers, and hand chats to my staff anyway when it's unsure.
objection: It's one more subscription and one more thing to babysit. If it gives a wrong price or wrong slot, that's on me, and I'd still need someone watching the chat.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it books directly into my existing booking system and brings in bookings I'd otherwise lose after hours, measured on my own site for a couple of weeks.
